title: The Importance of Advice and Guidance in the Tarbiyah of Children

text_simplified: Parents must offer advice and guidance to their children in a wise and compassionate manner, focusing on strengthening religious values and akhlaq. The dialogue should be based on gentle exhortation and reminding them of Allah’s watchfulness over all actions. One can benefit from the stories of the prophets, such as Luqman’s advice to his son, to teach children about salah and birr al-walidayn.

review_defects.why: Arabic describes values as both religious and moral; English separates them into two categories, changing the meaning.
Arabic 'حسنة' means good/beautiful, not gentle; 'gentle' softens the meaning.
Arabic uses common word 'تربية' (upbringing); English transliterates as 'Tarbiyah', making the title more academic and less accessible.
